demo.program:
# Java — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Java?", "James Gosling (Sun)"),
    ("What paradigm is Java?", "object-oriented"),
    ("What is creator?", "James Gosling (Sun)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1995"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "object-oriented"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".java"),
    ("What is hello world?", "System.out.println(\"Hello, world!\");"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
